title: Geek Bar Pulse X Platinum Edition Disposable Vape Device – Strawberry Twist Ice
description:
Description
Warranty
Luscious strawberry sweetness meets a refreshing icy finish for an irresistibly cool and vibrant vape experience!
Step into the future of vaping with the Geek Bar Pulse X Platinum Edition Disposable, the next evolution of the beloved Geek Bar Pulse X—now reimagined with an ultra-premium matte platinum steel finish and a dazzling dynamic screen! The Geek Bar Pulse X Platinum Edition Disposable takes innovation to the next level, combining luxurious design with unmatched functionality for an experience as bold as its look.
This innovative device features the world’s first 3D curved screen, delivering vibrant animations while keeping you informed with real-time e-liquid and battery levels. With a massive 20ML e-liquid capacity, the Pulse X Platinum Edition offers up to 25,000 puffs in Regular Mode for all-day satisfaction or an intense, flavour-packed experience with 15,000 puffs in Pulse Mode.
An adjustable airflow system and output modes, controlled via a discreet underside switch, let you fine-tune every puff. Paired with advanced dual vertical mesh coils, every puff delivers consistent, rich flavour from the first hit to the last. The ergonomic mouthpiece adds comfort, while USB Type-C fast charging powers the device to 80% in just 20 minutes, so you’re never left waiting.
Up to 25,000 Puffs With Regular Mode.
Up to 15,000 Puffs With Pulse Mode.
Premium Matte Platinum Steel Finish.
Pulse Mode For Enhanced Airflow, Vapour And Flavour.
Dynamic 3D Curved Screen with E-Liquid and Battery Indicators.
Quick Charging via USB-Type C.
Dual Mesh Coil.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
DEVICE & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a device or disposable vape device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty devices or disposable vape devices without their original packaging.
